newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May rubber imports climb 6.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May rubber imports climb 6.1 pct.

text.p: China imported 194,904 tonnes of natural rubber, including latex, in the first five months, up 6.1 percent over the same period of 1996, the China Securities newspaper said on Tuesday, quoting customs figures.
Imports for May alone were 38,602 tonnes.
Imports of natural rubber, including latex, were 550,000 tonnes in 1996, up 72.1 percent from 1995.
Imports of synthetic rubber, including latex, in the first five months were 164,064 tonnes, up 15.5 percent. Imports for May alone were 39,773 tonnes, it said.
Imports in 1996 were 367,456 tonnes, a rise of 17.9 percent compared with the previous year.
